name: RASTER
description: A digital-first identity for a motion and code studio. A broken pixel diamond, cold neutrals, and a flicker of acid green create an unmistakable computational character.
heading: space-grotesk
rules: Pixel shapes snap to a square grid without rounded corners.
Use phosphor to identify one focal point per composition.
Set captions as compact mono data labels at the canvas edges.

system.concept: Dithered dimensional objects, scanner-like framing, broken grid glyphs, and compact machine labels. A digital visual world with an intentionally crafted edge.
headline: A sharper view.
A different resolution.
features: A visual practice that finds character in the smallest units.
Experimental systems that are also ready for the real world.
Work that keeps an idea clear across frames and formats.
system.layoutNote: Carbon hero, phosphor type, dithered artifact, and scan-line boundaries. Square pixels and mono captions; a strict data grid anchors experimental imagery.
